title: Grace Ferro Exports (exporter)
summary: **Role:** bulk distributor and exporter of Crosspaulin™ tarpaulins. It is **not** the manufacturer; see [manufacturer.md](manufacturer.md).

title: Manufacturer, Malsons Polymers Ltd (PANKAJ®)
summary: Confirmed by the manufacturer's information sheet on Malsons letterhead (S12) and its ISO certificate (S13).

title: Crosspaulin product overview and advantages
headings: Advantages and where each claim comes from
summary: A tarpaulin made by bonding oriented polyethylene film layers at crossed angles into one sheet. An ordinary tarpaulin is woven from flat HDPE tapes and then coated. Cross-lamination spreads strength in more than one direction and leaves no weave to fray or leak. The surface has a fine crossed texture (photo: `images/crosspaulin_cross_braid.jpeg`).

title: Applications and use cases
summary: Listed by the exporter (S5): heavy-duty waterproof tarpaulin, agricultural tarpaulin, industrial covering sheets, truck covers, ground covers, storage covers, temporary weather protection. Sectors: agriculture, industry, construction, transportation.

title: Micropaulin: product and test data
headings: Certificate of Analysis, 200 GSM black/silver (M1, dated 2026-10-31)

Grace Ferro is the distributor and exporter. Sources: [`micropaulin/sources.md`](../micropaulin/sources.md).

title: Micropaulin brochure: brand and design
headings: Palette (blue and red sampled from the logo, M2)
summary: The logo colours are almost the same as Crosspaulin's (both PANKAJ® brands), so the brochure is deliberately a sibling: Montserrat headings and Inter body, as in Crosspaulin. It is told apart by the banner's motif: yellow diagonal stripes under a blue curve (cover band, page-top strip, contact band).
